passages.title: A Community Repair Workshop
passages.text:
On Sunday morning, the community centre hosted a repair workshop for residents. Before the doors opened, volunteers were arranging the tables while the coordinator was checking the sign-in sheets. At nine o’clock, the first visitors arrived with small household items. While one volunteer was recording a visitor’s request, another was showing a resident where to wait.

A little later, the presenter was explaining the workshop schedule when the projector suddenly stopped working. The team paused the presentation because the schedule was no longer visible on the screen. While a technician checked the equipment, the coordinator handed out printed copies of the programme. The presentation continued after the projector worked again.

By midday, visitors spoke with the volunteers and collected their items. The coordinator thanked everyone for waiting. I worried that the interruption might delay the workshop, but the team adjusted the plan and completed the activities.
